practices.objective: Manage IT and OT Asset Inventory
practices.text: IT and OT assets that are important to the delivery of the function are inventoried, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Manage IT and OT Asset Inventory
practices.text: The IT and OT asset inventory includes assets within the function that may be leveraged to achieve a threat objective

practices.objective: Manage IT and OT Asset Inventory
practices.text: Inventoried IT and OT assets are prioritized based on defined criteria that include importance to the delivery of the function

practices.objective: Manage IT and OT Asset Inventory
practices.text: Prioritization criteria include consideration of the degree to which an asset within the function may be leveraged to achieve a threat objective

practices.objective: Manage IT and OT Asset Inventory
practices.text: The IT and OT inventory includes attributes that support cybersecurity activities (for example, location, asset priority, asset owner, operating system, and firmware versions)

practices.objective: Manage IT and OT Asset Inventory
practices.text: The IT and OT asset inventory is complete (the inventory includes all assets within the function)

practices.objective: Manage IT and OT Asset Inventory
practices.text: The IT and OT asset inventory is current, that is, it is updated periodically and according to defined triggers, such as system changes

practices.objective: Manage IT and OT Asset Inventory
practices.text: Data is destroyed or securely removed from IT and OT assets prior to redeployment and at end of life

practices.objective: Manage Information Asset Inventory
practices.text: Information assets that are important to the delivery of the function (for example, SCADA set points and customer information) are inventoried, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Manage Information Asset Inventory
practices.text: The information asset inventory includes information assets within the function that may be leveraged to achieve a threat objective

practices.objective: Manage Information Asset Inventory
practices.text: Inventoried information assets are categorized based on defined criteria that includes importance to the delivery of the function

practices.objective: Manage Information Asset Inventory
practices.text: Categorization criteria include consideration of the degree to which an asset within the function may be leveraged to achieve a threat objective

practices.objective: Manage Information Asset Inventory
practices.text: The information asset inventory includes attributes that support cybersecurity activities (for example, asset category, backup locations and frequencies, storage locations, asset owner, cybersecurity requirements)

practices.objective: Manage Information Asset Inventory
practices.text: The information asset inventory is complete (the inventory includes all assets within the function)

practices.objective: Manage Information Asset Inventory
practices.text: The information asset inventory is current, that is, it is updated periodically and according to defined triggers, such as system changes

practices.objective: Manage Information Asset Inventory
practices.text: Information assets are sanitized or destroyed at end of life using techniques appropriate to their cybersecurity requirements

practices.objective: Manage IT and OT Asset Configuration
practices.text: Configuration baselines are established, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Manage IT and OT Asset Configuration
practices.text: Configuration baselines are used to configure assets at deployment and restoration

practices.objective: Manage IT and OT Asset Configuration
practices.text: Configuration baselines incorporate applicable requirements from the cybersecurity architecture (ARCHITECTURE-1f)

practices.objective: Manage IT and OT Asset Configuration
practices.text: Configuration baselines are reviewed and updated periodically and according to defined triggers, such as system changes and changes to the cybersecurity architecture

practices.objective: Manage IT and OT Asset Configuration
practices.text: Asset configurations are monitored for consistency with baselines throughout the assets’ lifecycles

practices.objective: Manage Changes to IT and OT Assets
practices.text: Changes to assets are evaluated and approved before being implemented, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Manage Changes to IT and OT Assets
practices.text: Changes to assets are documented, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Manage Changes to IT and OT Assets
practices.text: Documentation requirements for asset changes are established and maintained

practices.objective: Manage Changes to IT and OT Assets
practices.text: Changes to higher priority assets are tested prior to being deployed

practices.objective: Manage Changes to IT and OT Assets
practices.text: Changes and updates are implemented in a secure manner

practices.objective: Manage Changes to IT and OT Assets
practices.text: The capability to reverse changes is established and maintained for assets that are important to the delivery of the function

practices.objective: Manage Changes to IT and OT Assets
practices.text: Change management practices address the full lifecycle of assets (for example, acquisition, deployment, operation, retirement)

practices.objective: Manage Changes to IT and OT Assets
practices.text: Changes to higher priority assets are tested for cybersecurity impact prior to being deployed

practices.objective: Manage Changes to IT and OT Assets
practices.text: Change logs include information about modifications that impact the cybersecurity requirements of assets

practices.objective: Reduce Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities
practices.text: Information sources to support cybersecurity vulnerability discovery are identified, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Reduce Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities
practices.text: Cybersecurity vulnerability information is gathered and interpreted for the function, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Reduce Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities
practices.text: Cybersecurity vulnerability assessments are performed, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Reduce Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities
practices.text: Cybersecurity vulnerabilities that are relevant to the delivery of the function are mitigated, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Reduce Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities
practices.text: Cybersecurity vulnerability information sources that collectively address higher priority assets are monitored

practices.objective: Reduce Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities
practices.text: Cybersecurity vulnerability assessments are performed periodically and according to defined triggers, such as system changes and external events

practices.objective: Reduce Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities
practices.text: Identified cybersecurity vulnerabilities are analyzed and prioritized, and are addressed accordingly

practices.objective: Reduce Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities
practices.text: Operational impact to the function is evaluated prior to deploying patches or other mitigations

practices.objective: Reduce Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities
practices.text: Information on discovered cybersecurity vulnerabilities is shared with organization-defined stakeholders

practices.objective: Reduce Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities
practices.text: Cybersecurity vulnerability information sources that collectively address all IT and OT assets within the function are monitored

practices.objective: Reduce Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities
practices.text: Cybersecurity vulnerability assessments are performed by parties that are independent of the operations of the function

practices.objective: Reduce Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities
practices.text: Vulnerability monitoring activities include review to confirm that actions taken in response to cybersecurity vulnerabilities were effective

practices.objective: Reduce Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities
practices.text: Mechanisms are established and maintained to receive and respond to reports from the public or external parties of potential vulnerabilities related to the organization’s IT and OT assets, such as public-facing websites or mobile applications

practices.objective: Respond to Threats and Share Threat Information
practices.text: Internal and external information sources to support threat management activities are identified, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Respond to Threats and Share Threat Information
practices.text: Information about cybersecurity threats is gathered and interpreted for the function, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Respond to Threats and Share Threat Information
practices.text: Threat objectives for the function are identified, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Respond to Threats and Share Threat Information
practices.text: Threats that are relevant to the delivery of the function are addressed, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Respond to Threats and Share Threat Information
practices.text: A threat profile for the function is established that includes threat objectives and additional threat characteristics (for example, threat actor types, motives, capabilities, and targets)

practices.objective: Respond to Threats and Share Threat Information
practices.text: Threat information sources that collectively address all components of the threat profile are prioritized and monitored

practices.objective: Respond to Threats and Share Threat Information
practices.text: Identified threats are analyzed and prioritized and are addressed accordingly

practices.objective: Respond to Threats and Share Threat Information
practices.text: Threat information is exchanged with stakeholders (for example, executives, operations staff, government, connected organizations, vendors, sector organizations, regulators, Information Sharing and Analysis Centers [ISACs])

practices.objective: Respond to Threats and Share Threat Information
practices.text: The threat profile for the function is updated periodically and according to defined triggers, such as system changes and external events

practices.objective: Respond to Threats and Share Threat Information
practices.text: Threat monitoring and response activities leverage and trigger predefined states of operation (SITUATION-3g)

practices.objective: Respond to Threats and Share Threat Information
practices.text: Secure, near-real-time methods are used for receiving and sharing threat information to enable rapid analysis and action

practices.objective: Establish and Maintain Cyber Risk Management Strategy and Program
practices.text: The organization has a strategy for cyber risk management, which may be developed and managed in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Establish and Maintain Cyber Risk Management Strategy and Program
practices.text: A strategy for cyber risk management is established and maintained in alignment with the organization’s cybersecurity program strategy (PROGRAM-1b) and enterprise architecture

practices.objective: Establish and Maintain Cyber Risk Management Strategy and Program
practices.text: The cyber risk management program is established and maintained to perform cyber risk management activities according to the cyber risk management strategy

practices.objective: Establish and Maintain Cyber Risk Management Strategy and Program
practices.text: Information from RISK domain activities is communicated to relevant stakeholders

practices.objective: Establish and Maintain Cyber Risk Management Strategy and Program
practices.text: Governance for the cyber risk management program is established and maintained

practices.objective: Establish and Maintain Cyber Risk Management Strategy and Program
practices.text: Senior management sponsorship for the cyber risk management program is visible and active

practices.objective: Establish and Maintain Cyber Risk Management Strategy and Program
practices.text: The cyber risk management program aligns with the organization's mission and objectives

practices.objective: Establish and Maintain Cyber Risk Management Strategy and Program
practices.text: The cyber risk management program is coordinated with the organization’s enterprise-wide risk management program

practices.objective: Identify Cyber Risk
practices.text: Cyber risks are identified, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Identify Cyber Risk
practices.text: A defined method is used to identify cyber risks

practices.objective: Identify Cyber Risk
practices.text: Stakeholders from appropriate operations and business areas participate in the identification of cyber risks

practices.objective: Identify Cyber Risk
practices.text: Identified cyber risks are consolidated into categories (for example, data breaches, insider mistakes, ransomware, OT control takeover) to facilitate management at the category level

practices.objective: Identify Cyber Risk
practices.text: Cyber risk categories and cyber risks are documented in a risk register or other artifact

practices.objective: Identify Cyber Risk
practices.text: Cyber risk categories and cyber risks are assigned to risk owners

practices.objective: Identify Cyber Risk
practices.text: Cyber risk identification activities are performed periodically and according to defined triggers, such as system changes and external events

practices.objective: Identify Cyber Risk
practices.text: Cyber risk identification activities leverage asset inventory and prioritization information from the ASSET domain, such as IT and OT asset end of support, single points of failure, information asset risk of disclosure, tampering, or destruction

practices.objective: Identify Cyber Risk
practices.text: Vulnerability management information from THREAT domain activities is used to update cyber risks and identify new risks (such as risks arising from vulnerabilities that pose an ongoing risk to the organization or newly identified vulnerabilities)

practices.objective: Identify Cyber Risk
practices.text: Threat management information from THREAT domain activities is used to update cyber risks and identify new risks

practices.objective: Identify Cyber Risk
practices.text: Information from THIRD-PARTIES domain activities is used to update cyber risks and identify new risks

practices.objective: Identify Cyber Risk
practices.text: Information from ARCHITECTURE domain activities (such as unmitigated architectural conformance gaps) is used to update cyber risks and identify new risks

practices.objective: Identify Cyber Risk
practices.text: Cyber risk identification considers risks that may arise from or impact critical infrastructure or other interdependent organizations

practices.objective: Analyze Cyber Risk
practices.text: Cyber risks are prioritized based on estimated impact, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Analyze Cyber Risk
practices.text: Defined criteria are used to prioritize cyber risks (for example, impact to the organization, impact to the community, likelihood, susceptibility, risk tolerance)

practices.objective: Analyze Cyber Risk
practices.text: A defined method is used to estimate impact for higher priority cyber risks (for example, comparison to actual events, risk quantification)

practices.objective: Analyze Cyber Risk
practices.text: Defined methods are used to analyze higher priority cyber risks (for example, analyzing the prevalence of types of attacks to estimate likelihood, using the results of controls assessments to estimate susceptibility)

practices.objective: Analyze Cyber Risk
practices.text: Organizational stakeholders from appropriate operations and business functions participate in the analysis of higher priority cyber risks

practices.objective: Analyze Cyber Risk
practices.text: Cyber risks are removed from the risk register or other artifact used to document and manage identified risks when they no longer require tracking or response

practices.objective: Analyze Cyber Risk
practices.text: Cyber risk analyses are updated periodically and according to defined triggers, such as system changes, external events, and information from other model domains

practices.objective: Respond to Cyber Risk
practices.text: Risk responses (such as mitigate, accept, avoid, or transfer) are implemented to address cyber risks, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Respond to Cyber Risk
practices.text: A defined method is used to select and implement risk responses based on analysis and prioritization

practices.objective: Respond to Cyber Risk
practices.text: Cybersecurity controls are evaluated to determine whether they are designed appropriately and are operating as intended to mitigate identified cyber risks

practices.objective: Respond to Cyber Risk
practices.text: Results from cyber risk impact analyses and cybersecurity control evaluations are reviewed together by enterprise leadership to determine whether cyber risks are sufficiently mitigated, and risk tolerances are not exceeded

practices.objective: Respond to Cyber Risk
practices.text: Risk responses (such as mitigate, accept, avoid, or transfer) are reviewed periodically by leadership to determine whether they are still appropriate

practices.objective: Establish Identities and Manage Authentication
practices.text: Identities are provisioned, at least in an ad hoc manner, for personnel and other entities such as services and devices that require access to assets (note that this does not preclude shared identities)

practices.objective: Establish Identities and Manage Authentication
practices.text: Credentials (such as passwords, smartcards, certificates, and keys) are issued for personnel and other entities that require access to assets, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Establish Identities and Manage Authentication
practices.text: Identities are deprovisioned, at least in an ad hoc manner, when no longer required

practices.objective: Establish Identities and Manage Authentication
practices.text: Password strength and reuse restrictions are defined and enforced

practices.objective: Establish Identities and Manage Authentication
practices.text: Identity repositories are reviewed and updated periodically and according to defined triggers, such as system changes and changes to organizational structure

practices.objective: Establish Identities and Manage Authentication
practices.text: Identities are deprovisioned within organization-defined time thresholds when no longer required

practices.objective: Establish Identities and Manage Authentication
practices.text: The use of privileged credentials is limited to processes for which they are required

practices.objective: Establish Identities and Manage Authentication
practices.text: Stronger credentials, multifactor authentication, or single use credentials are required for higher risk access (such as privileged accounts, service accounts, shared accounts, and remote access)

practices.objective: Establish Identities and Manage Authentication
practices.text: Multifactor authentication is required for all access, where feasible

practices.objective: Establish Identities and Manage Authentication
practices.text: Identities are disabled after a defined period of inactivity, where feasible

practices.objective: Control Logical Access
practices.text: Logical access controls are implemented, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Control Logical Access
practices.text: Logical access privileges are revoked when no longer needed, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Control Logical Access
practices.text: Logical access requirements are established and maintained (for example, rules for which types of entities are allowed to access an asset, limits of allowed access, constraints on remote access, authentication parameters)

practices.objective: Control Logical Access
practices.text: Logical access requirements incorporate the principle of least privilege

practices.objective: Control Logical Access
practices.text: Logical access requirements incorporate the principle of separation of duties

practices.objective: Control Logical Access
practices.text: Logical access requests are reviewed and approved by the asset owner

practices.objective: Control Logical Access
practices.text: Logical access privileges that pose higher risk to the function receive additional scrutiny and monitoring

practices.objective: Control Logical Access
practices.text: Logical access privileges are reviewed and updated to ensure conformance with access requirements periodically and according to defined triggers, such as changes to organizational structure, and after any temporary elevation of privileges

practices.objective: Control Logical Access
practices.text: Anomalous logical access attempts are monitored as indicators of cybersecurity events

practices.objective: Control Physical Access
practices.text: Physical access controls (such as fences, locks, and signage) are implemented, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Control Physical Access
practices.text: Physical access privileges are revoked when no longer needed, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Control Physical Access
practices.text: Physical access logs are maintained, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Control Physical Access
practices.text: Physical access requirements are established and maintained (for example, rules for who is allowed to access an asset, how access is granted, limits of allowed access)

practices.objective: Control Physical Access
practices.text: Physical access requirements incorporate the principle of least privilege

practices.objective: Control Physical Access
practices.text: Physical access requirements incorporate the principle of separation of duties

practices.objective: Control Physical Access
practices.text: Physical access requests are reviewed and approved by the asset owner

practices.objective: Control Physical Access
practices.text: Physical access privileges that pose higher risk to the function receive additional scrutiny and monitoring

practices.objective: Control Physical Access
practices.text: Physical access privileges are reviewed and updated

practices.objective: Control Physical Access
practices.text: Physical access is monitored to identify potential cybersecurity events

practices.objective: Perform Logging
practices.text: Logging is occurring for assets that are important to the delivery of the function, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Perform Logging
practices.text: Logging is occurring for assets within the function that may be leveraged to achieve a threat objective, wherever feasible

practices.objective: Perform Logging
practices.text: Logging requirements are established and maintained for IT and OT assets that are important to the delivery of the function and assets within the function that may be leveraged to achieve a threat objective

practices.objective: Perform Logging
practices.text: Logging requirements are established and maintained for network and host monitoring infrastructure (for example, web gateways, endpoint detection and response software, intrusion detection and prevention systems)

practices.objective: Perform Logging
practices.text: Log data are being aggregated within the function

practices.objective: Perform Logging
practices.text: More rigorous logging is performed for higher priority assets

practices.objective: Perform Monitoring
practices.text: Periodic reviews of log data or other cybersecurity monitoring activities are performed, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Perform Monitoring
practices.text: Data and alerts from network and host monitoring infrastructure assets are periodically reviewed, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Perform Monitoring
practices.text: Monitoring and analysis requirements are established and maintained for the function and address timely review of event data

practices.objective: Perform Monitoring
practices.text: Indicators of anomalous activity are established and maintained based on system logs, data flows, network baselines, cybersecurity events, and architecture and are monitored across the IT and OT environments

practices.objective: Perform Monitoring
practices.text: Alarms and alerts are configured and maintained to support the identification of cybersecurity events

practices.objective: Perform Monitoring
practices.text: Monitoring activities are aligned with the threat profile (THREAT-2e)

practices.objective: Perform Monitoring
practices.text: More rigorous monitoring is performed for higher priority assets

practices.objective: Perform Monitoring
practices.text: Risk analysis information (RISK-3d) is used to identify indicators of anomalous activity

practices.objective: Perform Monitoring
practices.text: Indicators of anomalous activity are evaluated and updated periodically and according to defined triggers, such as system changes and external events

practices.objective: Establish and Maintain Situational Awareness
practices.text: Methods of communicating the current state of cybersecurity for the function are established and maintained

practices.objective: Establish and Maintain Situational Awareness
practices.text: Monitoring data are aggregated to provide an understanding of the operational state of the function

practices.objective: Establish and Maintain Situational Awareness
practices.text: Relevant information from across the organization is available to enhance situational awareness

practices.objective: Establish and Maintain Situational Awareness
practices.text: Situational awareness reporting requirements have been defined and address timely dissemination of cybersecurity information to organization-defined stakeholders

practices.objective: Establish and Maintain Situational Awareness
practices.text: Relevant information from outside the organization is collected and made available across the organization to enhance situational awareness

practices.objective: Establish and Maintain Situational Awareness
practices.text: A capability is established and maintained to aggregate, correlate, and analyze the outputs of cybersecurity monitoring activities and provide a near-real-time understanding of the cybersecurity state of the function

practices.objective: Establish and Maintain Situational Awareness
practices.text: Predefined states of operation are documented and can be implemented based on the cybersecurity state of the function or when triggered by activities in other domains

practices.objective: Detect Cybersecurity Events
practices.text: Detected cybersecurity events are reported to a specified person or role and documented, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Detect Cybersecurity Events
practices.text: Criteria are established for cybersecurity event detection (for example, what constitutes a cybersecurity event, where to look for cybersecurity events)

practices.objective: Detect Cybersecurity Events
practices.text: Cybersecurity events are documented based on the established criteria

practices.objective: Detect Cybersecurity Events
practices.text: Event information is correlated to support incident analysis by identifying patterns, trends, and other common features

practices.objective: Detect Cybersecurity Events
practices.text: Cybersecurity event detection activities are adjusted based on identified risks and the organization’s threat profile (THREAT-2e)

practices.objective: Detect Cybersecurity Events
practices.text: Situational awareness for the function is monitored to support the identification of cybersecurity events

practices.objective: Analyze Cybersecurity Events and Declare Incidents
practices.text: Criteria for declaring cybersecurity incidents are established, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Analyze Cybersecurity Events and Declare Incidents
practices.text: Cybersecurity events are analyzed to support the declaration of cybersecurity incidents, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Analyze Cybersecurity Events and Declare Incidents
practices.text: Cybersecurity incident declaration criteria are formally established based on potential impact to the function

practices.objective: Analyze Cybersecurity Events and Declare Incidents
practices.text: Cybersecurity events are declared to be incidents based on established criteria

practices.objective: Analyze Cybersecurity Events and Declare Incidents
practices.text: Cybersecurity incident declaration criteria are updated periodically and according to defined triggers, such as organizational changes, lessons learned from plan execution, or newly identified threats

practices.objective: Analyze Cybersecurity Events and Declare Incidents
practices.text: There is a repository where cybersecurity events and incidents are documented and tracked to closure

practices.objective: Analyze Cybersecurity Events and Declare Incidents
practices.text: Internal and external stakeholders (for example, executives, attorneys, government agencies, connected organizations, vendors, sector organizations, regulators) are identified and notified of incidents based on situational awareness reporting requirements (SITUATION-3d)

practices.objective: Analyze Cybersecurity Events and Declare Incidents
practices.text: Criteria for cybersecurity incident declaration are aligned with cyber risk prioritization criteria (RISK-3b)

practices.objective: Analyze Cybersecurity Events and Declare Incidents
practices.text: Cybersecurity incidents are correlated to identify patterns, trends, and other common features across multiple incidents

practices.objective: Respond to Cybersecurity Incidents
practices.text: Cybersecurity incident response personnel are identified, and roles are assigned, at least in an ad hoc manner

practices.objective: Respond to Cybersecurity Incidents
